Name: THROW_DIRECTION_SFX_PARAM_ST
Description: SFX for throws and grabs, by the thrown character's hit-spark material. The row ID is an SFX material (as in HitEffectSfxConceptParam): the thrown character's two SFX materials, so up to two rows play; the thrower uses the materials of its partner, copied when the throw starts. Material 139 (None) plays nothing. A Time Act Spawn FFX (Throw Direction) event picks the column by its index (0–30) and spawns the SFX at its dummy poly, with the material variation.
